group ingest "Facts (ingest)" {
  node Source "Source" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-agent/src/operations/read-source.ts"
  node Extract "Extract facts" ref="packages/core/compute/pipeline-rdf/src/stages/extract-facts.ts"
  node FactFeed "Fact feed" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-agent/src/types/BrainService.ts"
  node Index "Index" ref="packages/core/compute/brain/src/Encoding.ts"
}
group compile "Goals (compile)" {
  node GoalText "Goal text" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-agent/src/types/Goal.ts"
  node Compile "Compile" ref="packages/core/compute/brain/src/CompilePrompt.ts"
  node Replay "Check + replay" ref="packages/core/compute/brain/src/Compiler.ts"
}
group evaluate "Evaluate" compact {
  node Rules "GoalRules" ref="packages/core/compute/brain/src/GoalRules.ts"
  node Thread "Private thread" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-agent/docs/THREADS.md"
  node Check "checkAction" ref="packages/core/compute/brain/src/GoalRules.ts"
  node Act "Channels" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-agent/src/operations/send-message.ts"
  node GoalFeed "Goal feed" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-agent/src/types/BrainService.ts"
}
edge Source -> Extract
edge Extract -> FactFeed "RDF.Fact"
edge FactFeed -> Index "cursor"
edge GoalText -> Compile
edge Compile -> Replay "Datalog"
edge Index -> Rules "relations"
edge Replay -> Rules "activate"
edge Rules -> Thread "wake"
edge Thread -> Check "action"
edge Check -> Act
edge Thread -> GoalFeed "judgment"
edge GoalFeed -> Index "facts"
